keyDates.text: DEADLINE TODAY: Pentagon audit reports due from 30 universities on foreign-entity research collaborations. Non-compliance risks future federal research funding eligibility.
Public comment deadline on ED's sweeping accreditation overhaul NPRM (AIM rule). Final rule targeted for Nov. 1; implementation proposed July 1, 2027.
Federal court hearing on DOJ lawsuit over Harvard's admissions data compliance with federal investigation. Brown and Columbia have already settled.
OMB Uniform Guidance overhaul currently scheduled to take effect -- blocked by Senate CR through Dec. 11 IF House adopts Senate bill after Labor Day recess.
First Circuit oral arguments scheduled on Trump administration appeal blocking DHS from revoking Harvard's international student enrollment authority.
Target date for ED to publish final accreditation overhaul rule (AIM). Early Decision I deadline at most Ivy League schools for Class of 2031.
Senate CR government funding expiration deadline. Congress must act or face shutdown; House must adopt Senate bill's OMB grants-rule delay provision.
McMahon 'National Call to Action' deadline: All universities asked to post public statements on admissions transparency, free speech, research security, and national service.

charts.title: Estimated Annual Endowment Tax Bill by University (AEI Estimates)
charts.sourceText: American Enterprise Institute / Christian Science Monitor, Feb. 26, 2026
charts.footnote: Harvard, Princeton, MIT, Stanford, Yale pay 8% rate; Dartmouth, Penn, Vanderbilt pay 4%; Brown pays original 1.4% rate and has no major tax bill. AEI estimates based on IRS Form 990 filings.

charts.title: International Applicant Decline on Common App by Country/Region, 2025-26 Cycle
charts.sourceText: Common App End-of-Season Report, via Higher Ed Dive, Aug. 24, 2026
charts.footnote: Data covers Aug. 1, 2025 to July 28, 2026. Kenya (+30%) was the only top-10 source country to post a year-over-year increase. Domestic applicants rose 4%.

charts.title: Endowment Tax Rate Tiers: Selected Tracked Universities
charts.sourceText: PBS NewsHour / AP Analysis, NACUBO data, Aug. 2026
charts.footnote: Tax rate determined by endowment assets per full-time tuition-paying student. Threshold for 8%: >$2M/student. Threshold for 4%: $750K-$2M/student. Threshold for 1.4%: below $750K/student or fewer than 3,000 students.
